patch.summary: AdCreative.ai implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement AdCreative.ai by mapping current ai workflows to AdCreative.ai objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Facebook Ads, Google Ads) after data checks.
bullets: Start with: LLM chat and assistants
Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on Facebook Ads

blocks.heading: AdCreative.ai day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat AdCreative.ai setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, image generation before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Paid media teams and agencies generating ad variants at scale before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Facebook Ads and Google Ads before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Starter list price is a higher entry floor than presentation tools like Gamma
Do not expand seats until LLM chat and assistants is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Starter list price is a higher entry floor than presentation tools like Gamma

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Credit-based creative generation — heavy campaigns raise TCO

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Not a general LLM assistant or full marketing automation suite

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Presentation and website jobs belong to Gamma or Wegic

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: AdCreative.ai plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Starter
lines.description: 7-day trial · Unlocks: LLM chat and assistants, writing and paraphrasing, image generation · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Professional
lines.description: 7-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Ultimate
lines.description: 7-day trial · Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate ai fit before a deep AdCreative.ai rollout
blocks.body: If AdCreative.ai fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft AdCreative.ai object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on LLM chat and assistants
If blocked, evaluate Gamma before sunk-cost expansion
